About the job

JOB SUMMARY

The Product Manager works under the Director of Product Management. This position encompasses product management over all departments and products within the company. The Product Manager is a champion for new product introduction that will drive long-term growth for Red Gold and is a knowledge center for the entire product portfolio.

PRINCIPLE ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Be a knowledge expert of product categories and competitive product offerings in the marketplace
  • Champion NPI projects from ideation to commercialization
  • Develop internal and external selling presentations and materials

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • 4 year degree – B.S. or B.A. Degree in Business / Marketing
  • 5+ years of experience in product development, marketing, and/or sales
  • Experience with project management and data analysis

JOB COMPETENCIES

  • Ethics/ Integrity/ Trust
  • Planning/ Organizing
  • Creativity and Innovation
